parent = list(range(n))
rank   = [0] * n
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]   # path compression
        x = parent[x]
    return x
def union(a, b):
    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
    if ra == rb: return False
    if rank[ra] < rank[rb]: ra, rb = rb, ra
    parent[rb] = ra
    if rank[ra] == rank[rb]: rank[ra] += 1
    return True

bs-partition-2sorted:
# Median of two sorted arrays in O(log min(m,n)):
if len(A) > len(B): A, B = B, A
m, n = len(A), len(B); half = (m + n + 1) // 2
lo, hi = 0, m
while lo <= hi:
    i = (lo + hi) // 2; j = half - i
    aL = A[i-1] if i > 0 else -inf
    aR = A[i]   if i < m else  inf
    bL = B[j-1] if j > 0 else -inf
    bR = B[j]   if j < n else  inf
    if aL <= bR and bL <= aR:
        # found partition
        if (m+n) % 2: return max(aL, bL)
        return (max(aL, bL) + min(aR, bR)) / 2
    elif aL > bR: hi = i - 1
    else:          lo = i + 1

# Count smaller-after-self via merge sort:
def sort(arr_with_idx):
    if len(arr_with_idx) <= 1: return arr_with_idx
    mid = len(arr_with_idx) // 2
    L = sort(arr_with_idx[:mid])
    R = sort(arr_with_idx[mid:])
    # Merge: when pulling from L, count remaining R already smaller.
    return merge_counting(L, R)

def trim(node, lo, hi):    # e.g. trim BST to [lo, hi]
    if not node: return None
    if node.val < lo: return trim(node.right, lo, hi)
    if node.val > hi: return trim(node.left,  lo, hi)
    node.left  = trim(node.left,  lo, hi)
    node.right = trim(node.right, lo, hi)
    return node                # parent re-links via the return value
